description: SWC Mac demo evidence inventory; not a binary-similarity configuration or score report.
reference: Super Wing Commander Mac demo 1.0.2, extracted 68000 CODE resources
address_convention: Byte offsets from the start of each CODE resource, including its segment header; end offsets are exclusive.
validation_strategy: Original instructions, format checks, real-demo integration and shared WC1 runtime tests. SWC binary scoring is not planned without the original Mac toolchain.

functions.differences: Enyo 1 Shotglass/Paladin/Angel roster, original room artwork and hotspot coordinates. Shares WC1 hit testing and campaign state. SDL events/cursors/text replace Mac hardware presentation. Original idle programs use a provisional host clock; hover/decorative animations and music are pending. Simulator restriction follows CODE_09 GameFlow +0x1b8e. Debug mission/campaign selection is excluded.

Original background and eleven room/bunk hotspots; bar, briefing and medals are connected. Bunks display an explicit unsupported-save message. No WC1 save files are written. Hover/decorative animation and save/name-entry dialogs are pending.
Uses WC1 pilot records and the common kills*1000-missions+1 ranking rule, original RCRM/3 art and DATA/0 +0x2690 rows. SDL bitmap labels replace QuickDraw fonts and formatting.

Draws original RCRM/46 background, badge frames and medal frames from shared WC1 campaign state, retaining the (-109,-77) origin and DATA/0 +0x42f2 lookup. SDL events replace the modal Mac input loop.

Supports BRF0/5 sections 0,4,6,8, with the original 13-byte WC1 record layout, shared ParseTests/AddPCName/animation parsers, original portraits/backgrounds and speech. Validates data before legacy parsers. Does not call the DOS renderer. Map uses WC1 objectives and transforms. Native panning, text colors, fades and audio-marker lip synchronization are pending; animations/subtitles use host presentation.

Original nine-clip order with Hornet suffix 00. Uses the existing SDL path resolver; missing movies preserve direct flight. Skipping, quit and error are explicit results. Separate ARMOR.MooV music and palette transitions are pending. WC1's sprite-based scramble is not suitable for these assets.

SDL textures, per-movie palette conversion, queued PCM and event handling replace QuickDraw/Sound Manager. Adds pause/focus handling, explicit quit and skip-on-release; skips the complete launch sequence. External music and palette transitions remain pending.

Validates the demo's version-1 320x240 container, record spans, 256-color table and 8-bit mono audio. Uses owned host buffers; ignores persisted Mac pointers. LMFillPixMap +0x1e5e supplies the initial pixel value. Palette order follows +0x2590..+0x25bc. Host limits files to 64 MiB and frame rate to 1..60; rounds 16.16 sample rate to integer Hz.
Releases host-owned record, pixel, PCM and file buffers. SDL presentation owns and closes its audio device and textures.

Preserves record-order video deltas and skipping of audio records (+0x18c4..+0x199e). SwcMovieOpen collects PCM using the remaining-sample counter semantics at +0x1c42..+0x1c78, excluding padding even after a 0x11 audio marker. SdlPlaySwcMovie replaces asynchronous Mac disk buffers, timers and Sound Manager; no emulation of that I/O machinery.

Preserves end-row, short/long skip/literal/repeat and no-op command semantics, including retained pixels between frames. Adds source/destination bounds and exact-consumption checks. Contiguous indexed pixels replace the QuickDraw pixmap; SDL uploads the full image instead of using the original dirty rectangle.
Explicit buffer length, index/format checks and host frame descriptor replace a Mac Handle and an A0 pointer return.
The SDL adapter decodes a whole frame; original clipped drawing and hotspot placement are not reconstructed.
Owned SDL buffers replace Mac Handles, purge state and cached pointers. File bytes and output lengths are validated.
Allocation and BE size prefix handling move to the caller; explicit bounds/exact-consumption checks are added; Mac debugger callbacks are absent.
Decode big-endian records into existing WC1 mission structures, validate narrower fields and references, then publish atomically. The original copies Mac records directly.
Adds signed frame x/y offsets to the draw origin. SDL cached textures and renderer clipping replace the Mac drawing pipeline; this does not reconstruct the whole original routine.

Uses the Hornet's original frame-selection formulas and maxima with shared WC1 fuel, throttle and energy state. Ship definitions remain WC1; explicit capacity guards, frame bounds and a wider fuel-product intermediate replace unchecked arithmetic.

Presents hull, armor flash and shield-presence sprites from WC1 state. SdlUpdateSwcCockpit supplies the original component cycle and malfunction check; SdlDrawSwcCockpit respects VDU modes and physical damage.

Reuses WC1 classification, transforms, scanner mapping and objective range. Uses SWC's 30,000-unit cutoff, contact-frame mapping, selected-contact blink, navigation activation and grid draw order. SwcUpdateCockpitScanner retains/selects a hostile and chooses CKPT/1 direction frames using the original thresholds; arrows are suppressed outside range to avoid stale coordinates. Physical radar damage disables contacts and arrows. Updates run on simulation ticks.

Uses the original target hull, four armor-flash frames, shield-presence thresholds and Hornet position. Reads WC1 state and capacities; the caller respects target mode, component-five malfunction and physical VDU damage.

Normal CKPT/1 reticle and original position; ITTS and lock-marker animation remain pending. Target brackets use SDL corners around rotated sprite bounds rather than MacScale1 bounds and CKPT/36. Spatial HUD precedes the cockpit artwork; text remains a separate overlay.

Spatial HUD is composed before cockpit art, followed by instruments/text and persistent damage/sparks. SDL masks markers with cockpit transparency. Banking, hands, side/rear views and communication are pending.

Seven-tick warning refresh reuses WC1 auto_pilot_valid, missile_on_tail and calculate_damage_level. Original PC00/12, /14 and /13 lamps, low-shield threshold and damage-light cadence; alarms are silent. SWC-specific autopilot escort gates and travel are not connected.

Shared mode stack gates player/target displays and mode-zero static. SWC components 3/5 can temporarily replace their displays with static; physical damage suppresses the corresponding VDU. Demo navigation/damage/info routines are empty; communication modes remain pending.

Uses VDUS/1 and /2 (CODE_03 init_vdus +0x0914) and original Hornet polygons. Original random selection 0..2 is sampled per simulation tick; each resource contains four frames. SDL_RenderGeometry replaces MacDrawcel2.
Maps the full static image to the four VDU polygon corners, ignoring frame x/y. SDL textured triangles replace the original fixed-point polygon rasterizer.

Shared WC1 malf dispatches here only during SWC flight. Preserves damage-squared probability and the per-component 5..9-call countdown; uses WC1 RNG with adjusted inclusive bounds, not SWC's Rand16 generator.

Original component/severity strings and colors with show_weapon_disp's 30-update component cycle. Weapon text remains persistent with added ammunition/lock state, unlike original selection timers. Shared WC1 messages use host positions, font and lifetimes.
Three physical regions and their original origins; active sparks suppress another hit. Reuses the first three WC1 damage flags. Region bounds are checked and sound remains suppressed.
Draws PC00/7 frames 0..2 at the original Hornet positions after instruments/text. Other cockpits are unsupported.

Original eight CKPT/6 spark frames and offsets; SdlUpdateSwcCockpit advances/restarts them on simulation ticks. Repeat probability and position ranges use WC1 RNG with adjusted exclusive upper bounds. Audio remains absent.

shared_wc1_evidence.name: ParseTests
shared_wc1_evidence.qualification: Shares the branch parser after bounded validation. The carrier accepts goto, score and wing-status tests; Enyo 1 uses command 4 to gate Angel's interjection. Other scene families remain unsupported.

shared_wc1_evidence.name: AddPCName
shared_wc1_evidence.qualification: Shares player callsign expansion. The Enyo carrier validates $C markers and expanded length before using WC1's fixed scratch buffer. Other substitutions are not enabled in this host slice.

shared_wc1_evidence.name: TranslateEyes
shared_wc1_evidence.qualification: Same frame/duration/comma/R command language. WC1 emits short command pairs; the original Mac emits wider pairs. Host validates durations/termination and supplies adequately sized buffers.

shared_wc1_evidence.name: draw_nav_pointer
shared_wc1_evidence.qualification: Reuses allocation, objective-relative transform, view-cone/radius gates and projection. SDL-only SWC activation allows target mode; valid-objective guard and per-call invalidation prevent stale markers. CKPT/1 frame 3 replaces the host rectangle.

shared_wc1_evidence.name: your_internal_damage
shared_wc1_evidence.qualification: Shared WC1 impact and component-damage flow. Original +0x184a calls random_number(3), which selects regions 0..2; SDL changes only the cockpit-region bound. Other damage probabilities and definitions remain WC1.

shared_wc1_evidence.name: fire_players_lasers
shared_wc1_evidence.qualification: Same cooldown/energy gate and selected-gun call. VDU selection is routed to SWC state without invoking WC1 cockpit drawing.

shared_wc1_evidence.name: fire_weapon
shared_wc1_evidence.qualification: Shares allocation, hardpoint, energy, lifetime and launch flow. SDL-only SWC player convergence adds 400 units along up for lasers, 300 for neutron/mass driver (+0x34c8..+0x3532); laser refire delay is 4 from DATA/0 +0x31f2. Remaining ship/weapon definitions are WC1; SWC sound remains suppressed.

shared_wc1_evidence.name: fire_missile
shared_wc1_evidence.qualification: Same enabled-missile iteration and HS/IR lock gate. WC1 also queues the NEED LOCK message.

shared_wc1_evidence.name: fire_fixed_projectile_weapon
shared_wc1_evidence.qualification: Same iteration over enabled projectile slots, using WC1's packed seven-byte weapon layout instead of SWC's ten-byte slots.

shared_wc1_evidence.name: select_new_gun
shared_wc1_evidence.qualification: Shared gun selection; SWC's 15-tick status-text timer is not reproduced.

shared_wc1_evidence.name: select_new_release_weapon
shared_wc1_evidence.qualification: Shared preferred-type selection and enabled slot state; host text is persistent.

shared_wc1_evidence.name: house_keep_objects
shared_wc1_evidence.qualification: Same lifetime/cooldown stages. Retains WC1's debris-expiration behavior; SWC-only object classes are unsupported.

shared_wc1_evidence.name: update_objects_in_space
shared_wc1_evidence.qualification: Shares animation, collision, rotation, missile intelligence, energy, movement and shield stages. WC1 collision/damage remains in use; SWC's collision-candidate prepass is absent. NPC ship intelligence is explicitly skipped until mission/communication integration is ready.

shared_wc1_evidence.name: animate_shape
shared_wc1_evidence.qualification: Same frame/loop/scale/removal commands. Host supplies SWC explosion sequences and scales to WC1's interpreter. Original Mac handle management and the final ship-explosion frame's screen-shake trigger are not reproduced.

shared_wc1_evidence.name: replenish_weapon_energy_bank
shared_wc1_evidence.qualification: Shared one/two-unit recharge and 100-unit cap; capacities and shield state remain WC1.

shared_wc1_evidence.name: Build_objective_list
shared_wc1_evidence.qualification: Enyo 1 uses the existing WC1 objective builder; other SWC objective behavior remains unverified.

shared_wc1_evidence.name: nav_getxy
shared_wc1_evidence.qualification: The host currently uses WC1 map coordinates. The SWC original stores world coordinates shifted by eight in wider map fields.

shared_wc1_evidence.name: players_flight_dynamics
shared_wc1_evidence.qualification: Same axis-rate/input division, signs and blowing-up branch. Uses WC1 ship definitions and narrower rotation fields.

shared_wc1_evidence.name: rotate_object
shared_wc1_evidence.qualification: Same per-axis rotate/approach-zero sequence; SWC rotation fields are wider.

shared_wc1_evidence.name: celerate
shared_wc1_evidence.qualification: Same speed clamp to 0..maximum*256; the host still uses WC1 ship parameters.

shared_wc1_evidence.name: accelerate
shared_wc1_evidence.qualification: Same malfunction adjustment and celerate call. SDL multiplies signed steps by 256 to avoid negative-shift undefined behavior; reference expression is preserved.

shared_wc1_evidence.name: your_afterburner
shared_wc1_evidence.qualification: Same fuel/malfunction gates and eight/two-tick renewal. Sound scheduling differs; SWC sound calls are suppressed at the SDL boundary.

shared_wc1_evidence.name: fire_afterburner
shared_wc1_evidence.qualification: Same maximum-velocity*0x500 eligibility check and maneuver/timer update.

shared_wc1_evidence.name: accelerate_and_move_object
shared_wc1_evidence.qualification: Shared target-velocity, acceleration and boost/brake calculations. SWC scales the final displacement with a seven-entry elapsed-tick table; the host retains WC1's fixed-step movement. SWC also omits WC1's random kill-engines recovery.

shared_wc1_evidence.name: max_acceleration
shared_wc1_evidence.qualification: SWC also grants the one-third acceleration bonus to ratings 1..7. An SDL-only condition enables that difference during SWC flight.

shared_wc1_evidence.name: drain_fuel
shared_wc1_evidence.qualification: SWC recalculates maximum speed when remaining fuel is <=0. An SDL-only condition enables that behavior during SWC flight, preserving WC1's retail array-address comparison otherwise.

shared_wc1_evidence.name: update_digital_readouts
shared_wc1_evidence.qualification: Shares the actual and commanded speed calculations. DrawCockpitReadout routes only the speed slots to the SWC SDL text adapter, which applies original positions and four-digit zero padding. Other SWC text layers are not implementations of the full original routine.

shared_wc1_evidence.name: rotational_pos_to_scanner_pos
shared_wc1_evidence.qualification: Same yaw threshold/divisors and pitch divisor. SDL-only selection supplies Hornet bounds and the SWC +1 X adjustment before clamping (CODE_13 +0x25cc). WC1's reference branch is preserved.

shared_wc1_evidence.name: set_objective_range
shared_wc1_evidence.qualification: Shares mobile-objective update, player-relative transform, spherical conversion, optional scanner placement and distance shifted by eight.

shared_wc1_evidence.name: get_color
shared_wc1_evidence.qualification: Same contact class/side/target classification. The SDL adapter maps WC1 color values to SWC CKPT/31 sprite indices: hostile fighter 11, Imperial fighter 9, other fighter/Tiger's Claw 3, hostile capital 5, other capital 1, player-targeting missile 7.

wc1_control_reuse.qualification: DOS/Win32 controls are intentional. Held keyboard input is sampled per tick, with independent axis release. Mouse motion is passed to WC1 player_input using an initialized SWC viewport, preserving its response tables, signs and right-button roll/throttle. Only motion/modifier events are queued; the SWC host owns SDL event pumping and leaves weapon button states clear. Right double-click/hold uses WC1's timing-only 20/60-second interval and shared afterburner routine. Pointer capture is released on pause/focus loss, and SDL logical coordinates handle resizing and warping. The SDL host calls the shared gun/missile, selection and target routines directly. HandleSpaceFlightControls remains bypassed; unsupported mission/VDU commands are not dispatched. SWC's Mac event/device code differs.
wc1_control_reuse.validation: Original-instruction review, static source review, and native/GUI compilation only for the movement and mouse updates; no interactive execution.

cockpit_ui.scope: Enyo 1 Hornet instruments, target hull/armor/shields, normal reticle, navigation/hostile markers, warning lamps, component text, malfunctioning VDUs, damaged panels and sparks. Spatial HUD is masked by the cockpit; text/HUD also appear without it. Capacities remain WC1. Automatic acquisition, lock controls/animation, communication, cockpit banking, pilot animation, side/rear views, ITTS and other cockpitless instruments are pending. SDL2 2.0.18 or later is required for VDU polygons.

random_bound_evidence.qualification: Original small-range draws take Rand16 modulo the upper bound, excluding it. UI and damage-region selection adjust WC1's inclusive random bounds. The SWC RNG itself is not reproduced.

data_resource.offset_convention: Expanded A5-relative global-data offsets, not compressed resource offsets. Recovered offline using the original CODE_01 startup decoder, including its byte-command loop at +0x015e..+0x0230.

hornet_tables.meaning: scanner center X/Y, minimum X/Y, maximum X/Y
scanner grid origin X/Y and frame
damage light origin X/Y and frame
scene origin; reticle adds (-16,-4) before frame offsets
radar, left VDU, right VDU damage origins
cockpit resource list; selected chunks PC00/7, 9, 10, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18
shared cockpit resource list; reticle/nav/hostile CKPT/1, sparks CKPT/6 and contacts CKPT/31

text_evidence.name: AllocTextLayer
text_evidence.qualification: Defaults the font ID to 21 (Helvetica), not Monaco (4).

text_evidence.name: init_text
text_evidence.qualification: Cockpit readout layers pass font size 9.

text_evidence.name: tprintf
text_evidence.qualification: QuickDraw rendering; newline at +0x2214 advances by font size plus two. The SDL adapter is not a reconstruction of this text formatter.

substitute_font.license: SIL OFL 1.1; third_party/anonymouspro/OFL.txt; copied into release archives
substitute_font.qualification: Provisional nine-pixel monochrome ASCII substitute, five-pixel advance. No claim of original SWC typography or Monaco metric compatibility. Compiled bitmap requires neither SDL2_ttf nor a runtime TTF.

cockpit_ui.validation: Original-instruction, expanded-resource and offline glyph inspection; static source review; native and GUI compilation only. No game, GUI or interactive checks executed for this pass.

resource_mapping_evidence.name: get_Mac_mem
resource_mapping_evidence.qualification: CODE_03 init_3Space_objects aliases shared debris resources. Host caches independently counted OBJT, 22-frame missile MSnn/1 and 37-frame ship resources.

explosion_data.qualification: Consecutive frames starting at zero, then 0xa000 removal; one tick per frame. The host temporarily supplies these sequences/scales to WC1's animation interpreter and restores the original definitions on exit.

weapon_presentation.qualification: Rendering uses the original (160,100) plus projected XY, with horizontal/vertical flip bits retained. Sprite centering, WC1 scaling/ship definitions, and simple SDL target brackets are provisional. No original Mac handle management, screen shake or SWC weapon audio. NPC ship AI remains disconnected.
weapon_presentation.validation: Original-instruction and offline resource inspection; static source review; make modern modern-gui only. No interactive execution or tests.

movies.scope: Version-1 LMov decoder and original Hornet launch before Enyo 1 in both SDL launchers. Missing sequence files preserve direct flight; malformed movies fail explicitly. The check-only flight path bypasses movies.
movies.launch_string_evidence: CODE_03 scramble +0x45d0, expanded DATA/0 A5-relative strings -0x3414, -0x3402, -0x33fd, -0x33f4, -0x33eb, -0x33e2, -0x33d3, -0x33c4, -0x33b5. Last four format strings use %2.2d; Hornet selects zero.
movies.audio: Embedded unsigned 8-bit mono at 0x56ee8ba3 fixed-point Hz (22254.545...), rounded to 22255 Hz by SDL. Stored blocks are 11128 bytes; header +0xa6 is the valid sample count. SDL queues trimmed PCM, pauses with video, and falls back to silent playback if the device is unavailable.
movies.pending: Separate MIDI/ARMOR.MooV music (A5-0x340d), palette transitions, opening/landing/funeral game-flow integration, and later scripted scenes. First briefing/bar conversations are connected through the carrier adapter.
movies.validation: Original assembly and A5-string inspection; offline parsing of all 38 original files and 3521 encoded frames, including record bounds, scanline commands, exact frame consumption and audio lengths; static source review and make modern modern-gui. No interactive code, game, GUI, playback or audio device executed.

carrier.scope: Fresh Enyo 1: bar, three conversations, rankings, barracks, medals, briefing, Hornet launch, flight. GUI and CLI enter the carrier; check-only bypasses rooms and movies. Save bunks explain unsupported saving/loading. Simulator remains disabled as in the original demo.

flow_evidence.name: GameFlow
flow_evidence.qualification: RecRoom, BarracksScreen, Briefing and scramble; simulator selection shows the demo restriction.

carrier.reuse_qualification: Reference functions are unchanged. Original WC1 room/director functions also perform DOS resource and viewport I/O, so the host reuses their separable logic/data types and provides SDL presentation. Pilot identity, rankings and awards start from WC1's initial campaign template; the SWC character initialization template and name-entry UI are not reconstructed.

script.record: 13 bytes: three signed bytes, five LE16 fields
script.roster: CMP0/3 indexed by (series-1)*8+mission*2; Enyo 1 pair 5,4 is validated.

speech.format: AIFF COMM/SSND, mono signed 16-bit big-endian PCM, 11025 Hz; all 92 demo recordings inspected have this format.
speech.form_length_quirk: All 92 original files declare FORM four bytes short, apparently excluding the AIFF form type. Each final SSND chunk ends at physical EOF with exactly the PCM byte count declared by COMM. The reader permits only this exact four-byte overrun by a final SSND chunk; other bounds/sample-count checks remain in force. Observed directly in 04060000.AIF and the full original speech corpus without playback.
speech.evidence: CODE_03 SceneDirector +0x2cb6; DATA/0 +0x4322/+0x4326 resolves to %s%d:%2.2d%2.2d%2.2d%2.2d.AIF and camp.; SpoolSoundFile +0x6b02 provides original Sound Manager context. Archive supplies the mission subdirectory.
speech.qualification: Bounded host reader and SDL queued audio replace Sound Manager streaming. Missing/unreadable recordings or unavailable device leave subtitles usable; malformed present recordings fail. MARK chunks are ignored; script mouth/face timing is provisional and is not native voice-marker synchronization.

carrier.pending: Save/load and name entry, later rooms/scenes, campaign progression, exact idle/hover/decorative animation, native map/camera transitions, audio-marker lip synchronization, original text colors/typography, music and fades.
carrier.validation: Ghidra original-instruction and offline original-data inspection, static review and make modern modern-gui. Existing launcher fixture updated but not run. No tests, game, GUI, interactive checks, playback or audio device executed. Appearance and timing require user review.
